title: Vanilla+ Orientation
summary: A quiet Vanilla+ starter with Index, tutorials, PlayerCore, and optional map support.
body: A lightweight ECHO-enhanced vanilla starter that adds guidance, homes, optional map markers, and gentle survival goals without changing the core feel.
steps: Open Index from the keybind or guide item.
Use PlayerCore commands for a safe return path.
Treat HoloMap and missions as optional quality-of-life layers.
